note: Synonyms; commence is more formal/bureaucratic register than begin.
Same transaction (converse); passive 'sold to' backgrounds agent, changes focus.
discover=formal, find out=informal phrasal verb; same event, different register.
Clean converse: receive-from = give-to; same event, no register difference.
allow/permit near-synonyms; permit slightly more formal/legalistic register than allow.
succeed=formal role-succession term; follow=general; same outcome in context.
Teach doesn't entail learn (activity vs achievement verb); success not guaranteed.
